title: Basics of Autocrafting + Rocket Factory
description:
With this video I present some simple designs to vastly improve farm outputs as well as our first more complicated synchronous dropper crafter which we use for crafting TnT. I also demonstrate ways in which simple crafters can be combined to make a fully autonomous rocket factory.

I have an idea for what I might want to do for an opening sequence but really need some help from someone experienced with doing simple animations. Also let me know what you think of my videos, I am open to suggestions.
